guide_page_subtitle: A simple step-by-step guide to manage your workers, sites, and money. Each section shows a real screenshot — your app will look the same.
guide_tip_screenshots: All images are taken from the real Thekedaari app — your screen will look exactly the same.
guide_footer_note: If you see a red error message, read it — it usually tells you what to fix. Contact your supervisor or the person who set up the app if you need help.
guide_box_how_to_read_body: Each section has a title, a short explanation, a real screenshot, and numbered steps. Do one step at a time and check your phone after each one.
guide_s01_intro: Every time you open Thekedaari, start here. Enter your registered mobile number and password to access your account. First-time users must Register first (see Section 2).
guide_s01_steps:
Open the Thekedaari app.
Enter your 10-digit mobile number.
Enter your password.
Tap Login.
If you see "Invalid phone or password" — double-check your number and password and try again.
guide_s02_intro: Do this only once when you are new to the app. After registering, you will go directly to the Dashboard. You will not need to register again.
guide_s02_steps:
On the Login page, tap Register.
Enter your full name.
Enter your 10-digit mobile number.
Create a password — enter it again to confirm.
Tap Register.
The Dashboard will open automatically.
Note: Save your password somewhere safe. The app cannot show it again.
guide_s03_intro: After logging in, you land on the Dashboard. This screen shows your money summary, active projects, and worker count at a glance. Check this every morning.
guide_s03_steps:
After login, you are already on the Dashboard.
Top section shows Total Income, Total Expense, and Profit or Loss.
Below that, see how many projects are running and how many workers are active.
Recent transactions and today's attendance summary appear at the bottom.
Tap any number to open the related page for more details.
guide_s04_intro: Tap the ☰ button (three lines) at the top left to open the side menu. All features of the app are listed there. You can also use the bottom bar to switch quickly.
guide_s04_steps:
Tap ☰ at the top left of any screen.
The side menu opens — it lists all pages.
Tap any option: Dashboard, Attendance Report, Projects, Workers, Roles, Vendors, Transactions, How to Use, Profile.
The menu closes automatically when you select a page.
At the bottom of the screen, quick access buttons are also available for Dashboard, Attendance, Workers, and Projects.
guide_s05_title: Roles — Set Up Worker Types & Contract Work
guide_s05_intro: Before adding workers, set up their job types here. Common roles: Labour, Karigar, Supervisor, Contractor. For contract work (Theka), also add the type: for example Plumbing, Painting, Flooring, Tiling. These names are used throughout the app.
guide_s05_steps:
Open Menu → Roles.
Tap the quick-add buttons for the roles you use — Labour, Karigar, Supervisor, etc.
Scroll down to the yellow Theka section.
Tap quick types like Plumbing or Painting, or type a custom name and tap Add.
The roles you add here will appear when adding workers and recording contract expenses.
Do not add the same name twice.
guide_s06_intro: Each project represents one construction site or job. From the Projects page, you can view all sites, filter by status, and open attendance or finance for any site.
guide_s06_steps:
Open Menu → Projects (or tap Projects on the bottom bar).
All your sites appear as cards.
Use the filter buttons to narrow: Running, Completed, Small, Medium, Big.
Use the search bar to find a site by name.
Tap a project card to open: Attendance, Finance, or Edit.
Tap + (top right) to add a new project.
guide_s07_intro: Create a new entry every time you take on a new construction site or job. Give it a clear name so your team can recognize it easily.
guide_s07_steps:
On the Projects page, tap + (top right).
Enter the project name — for example: "Sharma House, Sector 12" or "Gupta Ji Flat Renovation".
Select the start date.
Choose the size: Small, Medium, or Big.
Tap Save.
The new project now appears in your Projects list.
guide_s09_title: Finance — Track Money for a Project
guide_s09_intro: Open Finance for any project to record all income and expenses for that site. Track money received, material purchases (cement, sand, brick), and contract work (Theka) bills. Labour cost comes automatically from attendance — you do not add it manually here.
guide_s09_steps:
On a project card, tap Finance.
Three tabs appear: Summary, Income, Expense.
Summary: total income, expenses, and profit/loss for this project.
Income: tap + to add money received — enter amount, date, and cash or online.
Expense → Material: add purchases like cement, sand, brick — enter item name, vendor, amount, date.
Expense → Contract / Theka: record contract work — select contractor, work type, and amount.
Always tap Save after filling each form. Unsaved data is lost.
guide_s10_intro: All the people you pay are listed here — Labour, Karigar, Supervisors, and Contractors. From each worker card you can mark attendance, open their salary ledger, or edit their details.
guide_s10_steps:
Open Menu → Workers (or tap Workers on the bottom bar).
All workers appear as cards with their role and daily rate.
Green Active badge means you currently employ them.
Use the search bar to find someone by name or phone number.
Each worker card has options: Attendance, Ledger, and Edit.
Tap + Add Worker to add a new person.
guide_s11_intro: Add every person you pay — Labour, Karigar, Contractor, or Supervisor. Their daily rate is used to calculate salary automatically when you mark attendance.
guide_s11_steps:
On the Workers page, tap + Add Worker.
Enter the worker's full name.
Enter their 10-digit mobile number.
Select their role: Labour, Karigar, Supervisor, or Contractor.
If Contractor: choose the Theka work type from the dropdown (Plumbing, Painting, etc.).
Enter their daily rate in ₹. Contractors can enter 0 if paid per contract.
Tap Save.
The worker now appears in your list and is ready for attendance.
guide_s14_title: Site Attendance — Mark All Workers at Once
guide_s14_intro: Open a project and mark attendance for all workers at that site in one place. Select the date, mark each worker as Present, Half Day, or Absent, add OT if any, and save once for the whole site.
guide_s14_steps:
Open Projects → tap a project → tap Attendance.
Select the date using the date bar at the top.
All workers assigned to this project appear in the list.
For each worker tap: P (Present), HD (Half Day), or A (Absent).
The day salary fills automatically from their rate. Edit if needed.
To add Overtime (OT): tap + Add OT and enter the amount in ₹.
To record a payment today: turn on Pay and enter the amount.
After marking all workers, tap Save Attendance at the bottom.
vendor_balance_advance: You have paid more than billed (advance).
no_vendors: No vendors yet. Add your first vendor.
guide_s15_intro: The ledger shows the full money record for one worker — all salary earned and all payments made. The Current Balance at the top tells you exactly how much you still owe them. Check this before paying a worker.
guide_s15_steps:
On the Workers page, tap a worker's card then tap Ledger.
The Current Balance at the top shows what you still owe this worker.
Green entries (+) show salary earned — added automatically from attendance.
Red entries (−) show payments already made to the worker.
To pay a worker: tap Record Payment → enter amount, select project → tap Save.
The balance reduces after each payment.
If balance is ₹0, the worker is fully paid.
Tap Add Earning to manually add a bonus or extra amount.
